gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-rubik: Big, bossy, wide open. Rubik follows in a soft sans with lowercase that looks large beside its capitals, though shrinking Baloo Paaji 2 would drain the commanding feel the heading depends on.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-bitter: Tall and confident, with generous openings. Bitter backs it up in grounded slab-serif lowercase with a very large eye, and a long page of it would feel dependable rather than tiring.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads modern and clean, its c ends pointing apart and its stroke never changing weight. Baloo Tamma 2 earns its place up top, big and short, where its roomy, distinctive lowercase can show off.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-inter: Baloo Tamma 2 has big counters in a tall lowercase, so nothing snags on a closed-up bowl. Inter then runs smooth, tube-like lines in a sans with its own breathing counters, which lets the two sit together comfortably.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-mulish: Baloo Tamma 2 is the commanding one, tall and open, built for a heading that grabs attention. Mulish does the quieter job in a sans with no thick-and-thin shifts, a large x-height and short ascenders that make steady reading easy.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-poppins: Poppins is modern and clean, with loose curves. Baloo Tamma 2 is the one that commands attention with its big counters, while Poppins quietly carries text in sturdy, tall lowercase with no thick-thin flicker.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-roboto-slab: Loud heading, structured text. Roboto Slab gives the line a dense middle zone and open throats on its a, c, e and s, and that precise slab-serif grip is what makes Baloo Tamma 2 look even bolder.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-rubik: Commanding and distinctive, Baloo Tamma 2 opens wide with tall lowercase and big counters. And Rubik, a plain sans with soft, open round letters, can be sized up a touch since its lowercase already reads clearly when small.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-instrument-sans: Baloo Tammudu 2 has tall rounded lowercase, with an e that opens up rather than closing its eye. Instrument Sans brings the pair's strongest quality, a sans-serif whose stroke widths stay put from stem to curve.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-mulish: Baloo Tammudu 2 is tall, rounded and commanding. Mulish takes over as a sans-serif with no tapering where strokes meet or end, and a bigger size for the heading would let that contrast show.
